content: An audiometrist in Australia possesses qualifications that differ from those of an audiologist. Typically, an audiometrist in Australia holds a TAFE qualification and must be accredited by a professional body to provide services to eligible pensioners and war veterans under the Office of Hearing Services program. Audiometrists are primarily responsible for conducting hearing tests, prescribing hearing aids, and performing other tasks related to hearing aid management. Most audiometrists also offer comprehensive rehabilitation services for individuals who use hearing aids. In rural areas, it is common for audiometrists to provide diagnostic services as well. Audiometrists have a long-standing history of delivering hearing care in Australia and were the first professionals to introduce hearing aids to the country. To become an audiometrist, one must complete a Certificate of Audiometry and undergo two years of supervised practice before obtaining a provider number. These provider numbers are issued by the Office of Hearing Services, a department of the Commonwealth Government. The majority of audiometrists in Australia are members of the Australian College of Audiology (ACAud). ACAud offers continuing education opportunities for its members, including both audiometrists and audiologists. It also facilitates the registration of new entrants into the Office of Hearing Services scheme. ACAud is at the forefront of developing a continuing education pathway for audiometrists in Australia. In addition to audiometrists, there is a related profession known as hearing instrument specialists or hearing aid dispensers. These individuals are required to obtain state licensure in states where it is mandated, and some may also pursue national certification. However, they are not required to have a university-level education. Unlike audiologists, hearing instrument specialists do not perform diagnostic evaluations of the hearing or balance systems. Furthermore, they are often restricted from working with children or individuals with medical complexities.
